import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-11-26"
start = datetime.fromisoformat(day+"T00:00:00").replace(tzinfo=TZ)
end = start + timedelta(days=1)
paths = [
  os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl"),
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl"),
  # archived omdb path
  os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/CHcode/data-jobs/archive/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl"),
]
for p in paths:
  print("PATH", p, "exists", os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      ts=o.get("ts") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("time") or o.get("timestamp") or ""
      # also nested
      if not ts and isinstance(o.get("payload"), dict):
        ts=o["payload"].get("ts") or ""
      ok=False
      if isinstance(ts,(int,float)):
        try:
          dt=datetime.fromtimestamp(ts/1000 if ts>1e12 else ts, TZ)
          ok = start <= dt < end
        except Exception:
          pass
      else:
        s=str(ts)
        if day in s: ok=True
      if not ok: continue
      n+=1
      src=o.get("source") or o.get("kind") or o.get("from") or ""
      text=(o.get("text") or o.get("body") or o.get("prompt") or "")
      if isinstance(text,dict): text=str(text)[:120]
      text=str(text).replace("\n"," ")[:160]
      bus=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or ""
      print(f"  [{src}] bus={bus} :: {text}")
  print("  count", n)
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, glob, os
paths=glob.glob('/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts/*/*.jsonl')
for p in sorted(paths, key=os.path.getmtime)[-5:]:
  print('\n###', os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p)), 'mtime', os.path.getmtime(p))
  user_bits=[]; asst_bits=[]
  with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for i,line in enumerate(f):
      try:o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      role=o.get('role') or o.get('type') or ''
      # cursor transcript format
      msg=o.get('message') or o
      r=msg.get('role') if isinstance(msg,dict) else role
      content=msg.get('content') if isinstance(msg,dict) else o.get('content')
      text=''
      if isinstance(content,str): text=content
      elif isinstance(content,list):
        for c in content:
          if isinstance(c,dict) and c.get('type') in ('text','input_text','output_text'):
            text += c.get('text','')
          elif isinstance(c,str): text+=c
      text=text.strip().replace('\n',' ')[:180]
      if not text: continue
      if r=='user' and len(user_bits)<8: user_bits.append(text)
      if r=='assistant' and ('完成' in text or '已' in text or '指标' in text) and len(asst_bits)<6:
        asst_bits.append(text)
  print('USER:')
  for u in user_bits: print(' -', u)
  print('ASST snippets:')
  for a in asst_bits: print(' -', a)
PY
